Subject: Re: Feliz 
 
Thanks. I'll sub soon. Dragging, had to write a feature after the game last night then this.

From: Manzullo, Brian
Sent: Saturday, July 11, 2015 12:40 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Feliz 
 
Nevermind, Tigers announced it. I’ll write something up real quick. Feel free to sub.

From: Manzullo, Brian 
Sent: Saturday, July 11, 2015 12:32 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Feliz

There was word last night and this morning that the Tigers are going to pursue Neftali Feliz, but I’m only hearing it from Pedro Martinez right now, so I’m just going to keep my eye out for more on it, if someone more reputable says something.
Just an FYI to keep on your radar, I guess. Hope you’re having fun in Minny. Can’t believe what happened last night.

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Dan.Lunetta@detroittigers.com <Dan.Lunetta@detroittigers.com>

Subject: Re: Feliz 
 
Nothing to confirm as of this morning.
On Jul 11, 2015, at 7:01 AM, "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
Pedro Martinez said on MLB Network last night that Neftali Feliz is coming to the Tigers. Not sure if it's a major or minor-league deal but if you can confirm anything, let me know.
